description: Returns full details for one KORKİMYA product by slug: CAS, UN, formula, synonyms, description, applications, specifications, packaging, shelf life, storage, product page URL and technical data sheet (TDS) URL when available. With lang 'en', specification names, values and methods are returned in English.

slug.description: Product identifier as returned in search results, e.g. 'c9-hidrokarbon-recine'.

name: get_product
title: Get product details
